summary.summary:
Migrated rdflib_sqlalchemy from SQLAlchemy 1.4 to 2.0 API. Changes:
- rdflib_sqlalchemy/sql.py: select([...]) list form -> positional select(*cols) with generative .where()/.select_from(); added _where() helper for optional WHERE clauses; table.select(clause) -> select(table).where(clause); union/union_all no longer take order_by kwarg, use .order_by(*...) method; raw "explain" string SQL wrapped in text().
- rdflib_sqlalchemy/store.py: select([...]) -> select(col); table.select(distinct=True) -> select(table).distinct(); table.delete(clause) -> delete(table).where(clause) via _delete_where() helper (handles None clause = delete all, as in 1.4).
- setup.py: SQLAlchemy pin changed from >=1.1.4,<2.0.0 to >=2.0.0,<3.0.0; alembic (companion dependency) minimum raised from 0.8.8 to 1.12.0 which is the first release supporting SQLAlchemy 2.0.
Test result: 44 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped (same pre-existing environment/known-issue skips: MySQL/PostgreSQL not available, "Known issue" markers).
Not changed, for review: Postgres path in _add_ignore_on_conflict still sets the private statement._post_values_clause; docs/conf.py intersphinx still points at SQLAlchemy 1.4 docs.
